130938: Nanako Yukishiro is a vibrant, cheerful high school girl. Nanako, however, carries one peculiar trait, instead of verbal communication, she pens senryu poems to express her thoughts and feelings. Nanako is outgoing, always wearing her heart on her sleeve.
133283: Eiji's Childhood friend and an acting older-sister. Ootsuki Koto is mischievous and playful, often hanging out around Nanako and Eiji, teasing them every now and then. She often gives Nanako advice whenever Nanako asks for help.
133284: President of the literature club. She is close friends with Nanako and Eiji. Katagiri Amane is a hard working, diligent girl and quite the hopeless-romantic. She cares for her club members and even helps them when they have a problem.
133285: Yakobe Kino is a member of the Art Club. She is a shy and honest girl. Much like Nanako, Kino likes to use a sketchpad to show her expressions and communicate. She gets nervous whenever she sees a person eye-to-eye. Kino is best friends with Tao and even went on a trip together.
133286: Eiji is an honest, straightforward and active young man whose actions often leads into misunderstandings due to his physical appearance, which causes his lack of friends. He is an ex-delinquent who joined the Literature club along with Nanako Yukishiro.
133287: Hanakai Tao is a fortune teller and goes to the same school as Nanako and Eiji.
182636: The younger sister of the Busujima family
221476: Nanako and Hiro's father. He is often paranoid about his daughter's wellbeing.
